name: mithril
first_pickup_chronicle: Mithril. Elven-make. It hums against my palm — and weighs less than a memory. The low-STR character's salvation: full armor for the weight of a tunic.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.40, weight_mult 0.55, no effective_against (T4 core). The DEFINING property is weight_mult 0.55 — near-half-weight gear. Pure utility through weight; the low-STR character's late-game upgrade path.
